To: sales@ngdata.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-16T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Order form kickoff + MSA questions — NGData / Redwood Inference

Hi Jordan / NGData team,

Thanks for the demo last week — excited to move to contracting. Attached is the draft order form and our latest MSA (Redwood_MSA_v3_marked.docx). A couple of items we need to lock down at intake so legal can prepare an initial redline: 

- Counterparty legal contact and signing authority (name, title, email).
- Billing entity and purchase order flow (invoice recipient, net terms).
- Hosting residency requirements (any EU/US-only constraints?).
- SOC 2 / security evidence cadence — do you prefer sharing a PDF or a link to your compliance portal?

Proposed short timeline: intake + party details this week, internal redline by 11/19, two-sided review week of 11/22, aim to sign by early December. If procurement needs a different cadence, flag below.

Attachments: Redwood_OrderForm_NGData_v1.pdf (order form stub), Redwood_MSA_v3_marked.docx (MSA - template).

Kimberly — can you take lead on redlines once we have their signer matrix?

Next steps for NGData: please reply with the three items above and your preferred signer flow (single signatory vs multi-signer). If you have a DocuSign account you prefer, share the account id.

Thanks,

— David Kim
Head of Contracting Operations
Redwood Inference

From: maria.gomez@ngdata.com
To: david.kim@redwood.com
Cc: sales@ngdata.com, legal@ngdata.com
Date: 2026-11-16T13:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Order form kickoff + MSA questions — NGData / Redwood Inference

David,

Thanks — Jordan looped me in. Quick answers below: 

1) Counterparty legal contact / signer: Maria Gomez, Head of Procurement (maria.gomez@ngdata.com). Final signer will be our CFO (Eli Park, eli.park@ngdata.com).
2) Billing: Invoices to billing@ngdata.com; PO-based purchasing with net 45 preferred.
3) Residency: We need US-only hosting for this initial deployment; may revisit multi-region later.
4) SOC2: We can provide a PDF of our SOC 2 Type II report and an internal security questionnaire (we'll attach).

Timeline: procurement prefers a one-week internal review once we get your redline; target signing by 12/02 is workable. We do have a preferred DocuSign account; details to follow in a separate email.

Attachments: NGData_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (will send in next reply), NGData_Purchasing_Profile.pdf

Also: Our legal team prefers that Redwood propose initial language on data residency and export controls — if you can flag the sections you intend to change, that'll help speed review.

Regards,

Maria Gomez
Head of Procurement
NGData

From: david.kim@redwood.com
To: maria.gomez@ngdata.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, sales@ngdata.com
Date: 2026-11-17T08:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Order form kickoff + MSA questions — NGData / Redwood Inference

Thanks Maria — this is great context. A few clarifications and asks: 

- US-only hosting confirmed; we'll mark Exhibit B (data residency) accordingly and produce a guarded redline.
- Net 45 billing noted — finance will map invoice contact and create billing cadence.
- Please send the SOC2 PDF and the purchasing profile when convenient; we'll attach to the intake ticket for audits.

Kimberly / Laura: please prepare an initial redline focused on (a) residency language, (b) liability carveouts, and (c) signature block options (single signer vs. CFO sign-off). If any clause needs legal escalation (IP, export controls), flag for me.

Maria — can you confirm whether the CFO requires countersignature from legal counsel or if signature alone is sufficient? Also confirm whether PO # will be inserted into the order form prior to DocuSign or after.

I'll schedule a 30-minute sync if you'd prefer a short intake call to walk through the redline priorities. Available 11/18 10:00–12:00 PT.

Best,

— David

Hi Maria / David,

I pulled the MSA and order form into an intake draft and attached my plan for the first-pass redline. Summary: 

- Planned changes in first pass: narrow residency language to US-only Exhibit B, clarify subprocessor list references, tighten the indemnity carveout (section 12).
- Signature options included in the order form: (A) single signatory (CFO) or (B) two-step (procurement sign + CFO final sign). We will prepare both block variants.
- We'll request SOC2 PDF and purchasing profile be attached to the HubSpot deal for audit traceability.

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_v3_marked.docx (redline draft), Redline_Workplan_NGData_20261118.pdf (tasked owners and timeline).

Questions for NGData: 
1) Confirm whether you want data deletion timelines in Exhibit C (we've proposed 30 days post-termination for transient data, 90 days for backups).
2) Please confirm PO insertion timing (before DocuSign vs after) so we can prepare the order form placeholders.

If it's helpful, we can do a 30-minute call 11/19 at 10:30 PT to walk the redline. Otherwise we'll circulate the initial redline by end of day 11/19 for your review.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
